name: Gieogeul Simneun Jeongwon
source: I was drifting through a meaningless existence, feeling as though I wasn't truly living. Then, one day, in a hazy dream, a place called the 'Garden of Planted Memories' emerged. It is said that in this place, I can erase a specific memory...?
